query: What Codex allowance observations did TiboTattle publish on its homepage during the last month, and what comparable allowance-tracking apps exist?

assumptions.text: Only the TiboTattle homepage is eligible as a source for numerical Codex crowdsourced allowance values.
Empirical allowance observations must fall between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-05 inclusive.
A user-reported allowance datapoint must identify its exact plan tier or be labeled not stated.
